description: Implementation of the GlobalFirstPartySets class managing first-party sets, including methods for finding entries, computing metadata, applying manual configurations, and handling set normalization within the Chromium project.

classes.name: GlobalFirstPartySets
classes.description: Manages collections of first-party sets, including entries, aliases, manual configurations, and methods for querying and modifying these sets.

methods.name: GlobalFirstPartySets
methods.description: Constructor initializing with version, entries, and aliases.

methods.name: GlobalFirstPartySets
methods.description: Constructor initializing with version, entries, aliases, and manual config.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current object.

methods.name: FindEntry
methods.description: Finds a first-party set entry for a given site, considering optional configuration.

methods.name: FindEntries
methods.description: Finds entries for a set of sites based on a given configuration.

methods.name: ComputeMetadata
methods.description: Computes metadata for a site, including context and top frame info.

methods.name: IsContextSamePartyWithSite
methods.description: Determines if a site is in the same party context as the top frame and party set.

methods.name: ApplyManuallySpecifiedSet
methods.description: Applies a manual set of first-party entries.

methods.name: ComputeConfig
methods.description: Computes a configuration based on replacement and addition sets.

methods.name: NormalizeAdditionSets
methods.description: Normalizes addition sets to eliminate overlaps.

methods.name: ForEachPublicSetEntry
methods.description: Iterates over all public set entries.

methods.name: ForEachManualConfigEntry
methods.description: Iterates over all manual configuration entries.

methods.name: ForEachEffectiveSetEntry
methods.description: Iterates over all effective set entries considering configuration precedence.
